newsitem.title: FRANCE: Unions disagree French public pay offer -minister.
newsitem.headline: Unions disagree French public pay offer -minister.

text.p: Civil Service Minister Dominique Perben said on Tuesday trade unions did not agree with an offer he made earlier in the day of a 2.8 percent pay rise over two years for millions of French public employees.
Perben held a news conference after meeting each of the seven civil service and public employee unions in which he announced the unilateral offer.

Two of the unions had already condemned the offer before he made the official press announcement and all the unions were to meet at 1900 GMT to consider their response, with the prospect of a strike looming large.

Several unions had said in advance of Tuesday's meetings with Perben that failure to in some way compensate for a pay freeze in 1996 could well result in a call to strike, probably for a day in March. (( -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5452))
